topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 248 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 30 ERC20 tokens, 11 ERC721 NFTs, 6 ERC1155 multi-tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 37 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc20upgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
